crossRefs.note: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They…
Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a…

translations.web: However in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.
translations.bsb: But in the church, I would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
translations.kjv: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
translations.asv: howbeit in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in a tongue.
